zh.schools.title: 哲学流派
zh.schools.sub: 同一组关于「如何生活、如何认识、如何共处」的问题，不同的传统给出不同的处方。点击卡片看详解。
zh.questions.title: 核心命题
zh.questions.sub: 哲学不是结论，而是一组反复被追问的根本问题。每个问题列出主要立场与为何重要。
zh.classics.title: 经典著作
zh.classics.sub: 穿越时间的文本：它们提出的问题，至今仍在我们的争论里回响。点击看要义与影响。

en.docTitle: Thought of Everything | A Plain-Language Guide to Philosophy
en.docDesc: Philosophy made plain: schools of thought East and West, core questions, classic texts and thinkers. Bilingual and ad-free.
en.heroSub: From Confucius to Kant, from Zhuangzi to Beauvoir — the long river of thought, in plain language. Neutral, structured, bilingual and free of ads.

en.homeLead: From schools to questions, from texts to people — pick a section to begin your journey.

en.entry.questions.d: Free will, meaning, good and evil, sources of knowledge, mind-body, justice
en.entry.classics.d: The Analects, Republic, Meditations, Critique of Pure Reason and other timeless works

en.ov.cap: One map to make sense of philosophy: the main threads from schools and questions to texts and thinkers.
en.schools.title: Schools of Thought
en.schools.sub: The same questions about how to live, know and live together — met with different prescriptions. Tap a card for details.
en.questions.title: Core Questions
en.questions.sub: Philosophy is not conclusions but questions endlessly asked. Each lists the main positions and why it matters.
en.classics.title: Classic Texts
en.classics.sub: Texts that outlast their time: the questions they raise still echo in our debates. Tap for the thesis and influence.
en.thinkers.title: Thinkers
en.thinkers.sub: Confucius, Laozi, Plato, Aristotle, Kant, Nietzsche, Hume, Sartre, Beauvoir — what each set out to answer.
